provenance.entries: Source tables verbatim or lightly reworded. Entries marked src=pocketrpg are original additions where the source gives only a prompt.

setting.premise: Folk of a frontier town get a visit from an ominous stranger.

questions.text: Why does the town exist, and what is it known for?
What landscapes or landmarks are nearby?

segments.name: A Typical Afternoon
segments.text: Normal town life and character interactions. As evening comes, give everyone a reason to be at the saloon or on Main Street.

segments.name: The Stranger's Arrival
segments.text: A dark-clad, heavily armed stranger rides in and heads to the saloon looking for trouble. Everyone interacts with him. Whoever bothers him most is called out to a duel at high noon. Play out the uneasy night.

segments.name: High Noon
segments.text: Whispers, bets, a crowd on Main Street. Show each character preparing. Stare-down, draw, fire. Player actions may change how it ends, but the stranger is dealt with. If he lives, he drinks and rides off.
